subcommands.name: get-action-recommendations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of recommended actions in sorted in descending order by prediction score.

options.name: --campaign-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the campaign to use for getting action recommendations.

options.name: --user-id
options.description: The user ID of the user to provide action recommendations for

options.name: --num-results
options.description: The number of results to return.

options.name: --filter-arn
options.description: The ARN of the filter to apply to the returned recommendations.

options.name: --filter-values
options.description: The values to use when filtering recommendations.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.name: get-personalized-ranking
subcommands.description: Re-ranks a list of recommended items for the given user.

options.name: --campaign-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the campaign to use for generating the personalized ranking

options.name: --input-list
options.description: A list of items (by itemId) to rank.

options.name: --user-id
options.description: The user for which you want the campaign to provide a personalized ranking

options.name: --context
options.description: The contextual metadata to use when getting recommendations.

options.name: --filter-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of a filter you created to include items or exclude items from recommendations for a given user.

options.name: --filter-values
options.description: The values to use when filtering recommendations.

options.name: --metadata-columns
options.description: If you enabled metadata in recommendations when you created or updated the campaign, specify metadata columns from your Items dataset to include in the personalized ranking.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.name: get-recommendations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of recommended items.

options.name: --campaign-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the campaign to use for getting recommendations

options.name: --item-id
options.description: The item ID to provide recommendations for.

options.name: --user-id
options.description: The user ID to provide recommendations for.

options.name: --num-results
options.description: The number of results to return.

options.name: --context
options.description: The contextual metadata to use when getting recommendations.

options.name: --filter-arn
options.description: The ARN of the filter to apply to the returned recommendations.

options.name: --filter-values
options.description: The values to use when filtering recommendations.

options.name: --recommender-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the recommender to use to get recommendations.

options.name: --promotions
options.description: The promotions to apply to the recommendation request.

options.name: --metadata-columns
options.description: If you enabled metadata in recommendations when you created or updated the campaign or recommender, specify the metadata columns from your Items dataset to include in item recommendations.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
